findings.cause: Official response has shape {jobs:{total_count,jobs:[...]}}. The current list extractor expects an array at the jobs key and rejects this nested envelope with UPSTREAM_INVALID.

Current official list_issues state enum is OPEN/CLOSED; capability probe sends open/closed. Runtime fails closed with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.
